verdict.rationale: Community discussion confirms core Bitbucket repo functionality — creating/hosting private repos (comm-2, comm-10, comm-15) and browsing commit history via a redesigned commits view (comm-6) — but the same threads also flag the web browsing UI as slow/clunky compared to GitHub (comm-1, comm-13) and lacking search/explore features. No first-party docs in the pack explicitly describe repo creation or commit-history browsing as features. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party documentation of repo creation/management and commit-history browsing UI, and independent resolution of the UX complaints about slow/limited browsing.
